name: enig-sales
description: ENIG's Isolated Sales workspace: one governed skill per Sales stage (enquiry, correspondence, call prep, call evidence with Call Notes, fit assessment, progression with the Sales → Strategy Handoff, Proposal release, client agreements). Explicit approval gates, strict evidence discipline, identity kept to the Registry, and Runtime-conformant attestation scripts. Built on the canonical Isolated Sales specification (LOG-1110, LOG-1140, LOG-1149, LOG-1164).
